Retrieved 2026-10-13 from the official MG Egypt spare-parts catalogue using
PoliteSession with a 5-second host interval. Actual public count is 150;
the cumulative native filter page 7 at size 24 returned 150 unique IDs,
143 part rows / 28 own codes and 7 merchandise cards without part numbers.
Parts fixture retains all rows for MG10767908 (HS brake pad), MG10343249
(ZS brake pad), MG10427930 (spark plugs), MGLPW100180 (oil filter), and
one unnumbered merchandise card. BeautifulSoup excerpts omit prices,
images, navigation and scripts; original product IDs and visible text
are retained. Bootstrap retains the actual page title and list metadata.
Tests use the excerpt card count, explicitly not the live count of 150.
Runtime archives complete unmodified HTTP bodies/form requests. Probes
are cached outside apps/parsers/.cache. No cart, login, contact, account
or captcha actions are called. Printed MG prefix is never removed.
